Road, Agartala, Tripura-799001. **...Respondent(s)** **For Petitioner** : Ms. Gayatri Aryan, Advocate, KMTL **For Respondent** : None ## ** ORDER ** Kohima Mariani Transmission Limited has filed the instant review petition seeking review of the order dated 28.6.2023 in Petition No.45/TT/2022. The Commission, in an order dated 28.6.2023, approved the COD of the two 400 kV line bays at Imphal Sub-station (hereinafter referred to Asset-1, as in Petition No.45/TT/2022) for termination of Imphal-New Kohima 400 kV D/C line under TBCB (under the scope of KMTL) under Regulation 5(2) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations and held that the transmission charges of the Asset-1 from its COD on 1.8.2020 up to COD of the associated transmission line on 31.12.2020 shall be borne by KMTL and thereafter shall be recovered from the pool. 2. During the hearing on 4.4.2024, the learned counsel for the Review Petitioner sought permission to withdraw the instant review petition. Order in Review Petition No. 36/RP/2023 Page **2** of **3** 3. Accordingly, we allow the Review Petitioner to withdraw the instant review petition. 4. The Review Petition No. 36/RP/2023 in Petition No. 45/TT/2022 is disposed of as withdrawn. **sd/sd/sd/(P. K.
